mensagens.input: Billy and Suzzy are running a lemonade stand in their local park. The recipe that they are using to make the lemonade requires 8 cups of sugar for every 5 pitchers of lemonade that is made. If they have followed the recipe and have sold 30 pitchers of lemonade, how many cups of sugar have they used?
Billy and Suzzy have used _____ cups of sugar.
